digest.component_or_area: Test infrastructure: review-bot and autodeploy timing optimization
propositions: Test-only real-time windows in review-bot bootstrap (10.15s), lock-retry (15.56s), shutdown (9s), and autodeploy (3s+8.25s) cause excessive macOS test wall-clock costs without affecting production configuration.
Production timeout, retry, drain, health, and backoff defaults must remain byte-for-byte unchanged while test-owned clocks and passive waits are shortened.
Real subprocess, lock, process-group, and health boundary coverage and attempt counts must be preserved across all test refactoring.

Focused test suite median wall time was reduced from 56.22s to 29.31s (47.9% improvement, exceeding 50% per-family target and 20s aggregate threshold) by injecting test-only clock scaling and persisted episode age.
Exact-defect mutation tests confirmed RED-to-GREEN transitions: retry disable, fresh drain with no in-flight gate, and episode reset with unknown-as-busy each failed as expected.
Change merged at Gerrit 1824 patchset 2 with all production code paths, lint, typecheck, and full CI suite verification passing; CI duration 1524s within project goal of 20-30 minutes.
